preconditions: Protected MEA task 019fdeb0-c2fc-7cc1-8d5e-1ba8166126ac completed and was idle before candidate release.

The current-main build wheel hash was independently verified as 69466464ae323af3b2702ccf56ca00de67d389cd4b51f87b605cc5d6fce54a21.
The old active object and candidate bytes matched their recorded hashes before mutation.
expected_postconditions: The artifact store has exactly one active epcsaft wheel and resolve returns the 694664 object path.
The old active object remains available for recoverable rollback and the released candidate remains only in compressed disposition evidence.
Downstream MEA applications lock the exact commit, tree, wheel filename, wheel hash, public API identity, and headers recorded above.
The focused Bülow ionic replay remains exact without rewriting retained evidence or running the unrelated neutral regression.
record.retry: Repeat only from the immutable current-main build and the recorded parameter/results paths; compare artifact hashes, active/object identity, archive member hashes, four Bülow rows, and all governed checks before any further alias change.
stop_conditions: Any active alias, object, policy, index, or archive hash differs from this receipt.
A candidate or other uncompressed wheel reappears outside active.
Any Bülow status, solver status, composition, density, pressure, ARD, or numeric delta differs from the retained four-row evidence.
The old object is missing or altered.
A downstream application requests source import, a fallback channel, or an unrecorded wheel identity.
A change would touch Engine equations, MEA chemistry, or retained scientific results.
record.reversibility: The active alias can be atomically restored from the untouched 21ed202df4aa5f8a516aa6400a3a09fe9b5e1d267935f6c5411b92e8faf9d049 object, with policy/index changes superseded by a new governance receipt. The released candidate and pre-promotion alias bytes are recoverable from the verified compressed archive.
record.irreversible_effects: The uncompressed candidate alias was removed after archive verification; no scientific results or old object bytes were deleted. The active alias and policy/index subject changed under the authorized promotion.
record.recovery_owner: The ePC-SAFT Engine owner must fail closed, restore only the preserved old object through a new hash-bound governance operation, and rerun artifact-store, installed-wheel, and downstream lock checks before release.
